capabilities: Syncs Memos entries into Obsidian notes
Generates AI summaries and tag suggestions
disambiguation: Not an AI writing assistant; AI only summarizes and tags memos after they are synced from a Memos server.
extras: Claude provider and prompt configuration are marked in development; compatibility capped at Memos v0.22.5; author asks for coffee tips.
problem: Memos content lives on a separate server and cannot be brought into Obsidian without manual export and copy-paste.

relations.evidence: A plugin that syncs Memos content to Obsidian, providing seamless integration.

requires.name: OpenAI or Google Gemini API key

summary: Sync plugin that imports Memos entries into Obsidian, organizing them by date and adding AI summaries, tags, and weekly reports.
